ACTION=A1
Rationale: A motorcycle is executing a cut-in maneuver from the adjacent lane into the ego vehicle's path at a close distance (approx. 26m ahead). The ego vehicle is traveling at 30 kph, and the motorcycle is moving faster at 9.4 m/s (approx. 34 kph). To maintain a safe following distance and avoid a collision during the cut-in, the ego vehicle must decelerate.
